contentEn:
A whole-home renovation in Vancouver or the Metro Vancouver area typically takes 4–8 months from permit approval to final walkthrough, based on Reno Stars project data from 2024–2026. A kitchen-and-bathroom whole-house project in Delta took five months. A Vancouver whole-house renovation with bathroom updates finished in five months. This guide breaks down every phase with real timelines from actual projects so you can plan yours with confidence.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

What Permits Does a Whole-Home Renovation in Vancouver Require?

Most whole-home renovations in Vancouver require a building permit from the City of Vancouver (or your municipality), and electrical/plumbing permits from Technical Safety BC. Heritage-status homes and suites in laneway houses add extra steps. Permit timelines vary:

  • City of Vancouver building permit: 4–8 weeks (pre-approval required for suites and structural changes)
  • Technical Safety BC electrical permit: 1–2 weeks
  • Technical Safety BC plumbing permit: 1–2 weeks
  • Heritage review (if applicable): add 4–12 weeks

Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of our full-service offering, managing the paperwork and follow-up with each authority.

How Long Does Each Renovation Phase Actually Take?

The table below shows actual phase durations from completed Reno Stars projects in Metro Vancouver:

PhaseDurationNotes
Design and planning2–8 weeksIncludes layout revisions and material selection
Permit acquisition4–8 weeksVaries by municipality; Delta and Surrey often faster than Vancouver
Material selection and ordering2–6 weeksParallel to permit phase; cabinets and quartz often 4–8 week lead
Demolition and rough-in3–6 weeksFraming, electrical, plumbing, HVAC; surprises behind walls can add time
Finishing and inspections4–8 weeksDrywall, tiling, painting, flooring, fixtures
Final walkthrough and punch list1–2 weeksDefect correction before occupancy

A kitchen-and-bathroom whole-house renovation in Delta — from permit submission to keys — took five months. A comparable whole-house project in Vancouver with bathroom updates also ran five months.

How Do I Shorten My Vancouver Renovation Timeline?

Three factors most often delay a Metro Vancouver renovation: material lead times, permit backlogs, and scope changes mid-project. You control the third; contractors and municipalities control the first two.

Choose stocked or fast-lead materials. Cabinet lead times are the most variable — standard white shaker cabinets from local suppliers can arrive in 3–4 weeks; custom quartz-topped island cabinets from overseas suppliers can take 10–14 weeks. Ask your contractor for lead-time options before finalizing selections.

Pre-select all finishes before demolition. Reno Stars clients who complete material selection during the permit phase start finishing work within days of permit approval rather than waiting for orders to arrive.

Lock scope before signing. Adding a powder room or expanding from two bathrooms to three after framing is complete typically adds 3–6 weeks and significant cost.

Real example: a Coquitlam kitchen renovation with a waterfall quartz island — new cabinets, quartz counters, flooring, and partial electrical — completed in approximately ten weeks from start to final inspection.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a small whole-home renovation take in Vancouver?

A renovation covering two to three rooms — for example, a kitchen plus one bathroom — typically takes 10–16 weeks from permit to final walkthrough in the Metro Vancouver area, based on Reno Stars project data.

Can I live in my home during a whole-home renovation?

Many clients do. For single-floor renovations, isolating one section of the home is usually feasible. Full two-storey gut renovations often require temporary relocation for 2–4 months due to dust, noise, and plumbing shutdowns affecting multiple levels.

What is the fastest way to finish a whole-home renovation in Vancouver?

Pre-select all finishes before the permit is approved, choose materials with short lead times, and avoid mid-project scope changes. Using a single full-service contractor who handles permits, trades coordination, and inspections eliminates the gap between phases that拖慢大多数项目。

Does renovating one room at a time take longer than a full-house project?

Yes — coordinating separate permits, separate trade bookings, and separate material deliveries for sequential room renovations typically adds 20–30% to total timeline compared with a single full-house project. A whole-house approach also reduces the number of site set-ups and mobilizations.

What does a whole-home renovation cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Whole-home renovation costs in Vancouver and the Lower Mainland typically range from $150–$400 per square foot depending on scope and finish level. A 2,000 sq ft whole-house renovation with new kitchen, two bathrooms, and flooring typically falls in the $300,000–$500,000 range including permits and labour. contentZh:
在溫哥華及大溫都會區，舊屋全面翻新工程從取得建築許可到最終驗收，通常需要 4 至 8 個月，此數據來自 Reno Stars 2024 至 2026 年的實際工程記錄。Delta 市一項包含廚房與衛浴的住宅翻新工程歷時五個月完工；溫哥華一項包含衛浴更新的全屋翻新工程同樣歷時五個月。本指南逐階段拆解真實工期，協助您精準規劃。

溫哥華舊屋翻新需要哪些許可證？

溫哥華大多數住宅翻新工程需向溫哥華市政府（或所屬市政當局）申請建築許可，並向 Technical Safety BC 申請電工及水管工程許可。歷史建築及後巷住宅附屬套間另需額外審查。許可證審核時間因類型而異：

  • 溫哥華市政府建築許可：4 至 8 週（套間及結構改動需先通過預審）
  • Technical Safety BC 電工許可：1 至 2 週
  • Technical Safety BC 水管許可：1 至 2 週
  • 歷史建築審查（如適用）：額外 4 至 12 週

Reno Stars 提供全方位服務，代辦所有許可申請，負責與各有關部門跟進協調。

各施工階段實際需要多久？

下表列出大溫都會區已完成項目的真實階段工期：

階段工期說明
設計與規劃2 至 8 週含平面布局修訂及建材選擇
許可證申請4 至 8 週各市政當局處理速度各異；Delta 及 Surrey 通常較溫哥華快速
建材選定與訂購2 至 6 週與許可申請階段同步進行；櫥櫃及石英石備貨時間通常為 4 至 8 週
拆除與隱蔽工程3 至 6 週結構、機電、管道、空調；牆內發現問題可能延長工期
飾面工程與驗收4 至 8 週石膏板、瓷磚、牆面漆、木地板、衛浴配件
最終驗收與整改1 至 2 週交付前缺陷修復

Delta 市一項含廚房及兩套衛浴的住宅翻新工程，從遞交許可申請到交付鑰匙共歷時五個月。

如何縮短溫哥華翻新工期？

大溫都會區翻新工程最常見的延誤因素有三：建材備貨時間、許可證積壓、以及施工期間變更範圍。第三項由業主掌控，前兩項則取決於施工方及政府部門。

選擇備貨充足或備貨快速的建材。櫥櫃備貨時間變數最大——本地供應商的標準白色鄉村風櫥櫃可於 3 至 4 週到貨；海外供應商的訂製石英石瀑布式中島櫥櫃則可能需 10 至 14 週。選定施工方前，務必詢問各選項的備貨時間。

在拆除施工前完成所有飾面材料選定。於許可審批期間同步完成材料選定的 Reno Stars 客戶，可在取得許可後數日內立即展開飾面工程，毋須等待材料到場。

簽約前鎖定工程範圍。在結構框架完成後新增化妝室或將兩套衛浴擴建為三套，通常額外增加 3 至 6 週工期及可觀費用。

實例：高貴林一項含瀑布式石英石中島的新櫥櫃、石英石檯面、地板及局部機電廚房翻新工程，歷時約十週完成驗收。

常見問題

溫哥華小型全屋翻新工程需要多久？

涵蓋兩至三個空間的翻新工程——例如一個廚房加一套衛浴——從取得許可到最終驗收，在大溫都會區通常需時 10 至 16 週，數據來自 Reno Stars 實際工程記錄。

翻新期間可以繼續住在屋內嗎？

許多業主選擇繼續居住。單層翻新工程通常可隔離部分區域居住。兩層住宅的全面翻新工程則往往需要暫時遷出，期間約 2 至 4 個月，原因包括粉塵、噪音，以及影響多層的管道停用。

加快溫哥華全屋翻新最快的做法是什麼？

在許可獲批前完成所有飾面材料選定、選擇備貨時間短的建材、避免施工期間變更範圍。委託同一間全方位服務承包商統一負責許可申請、各專業技工協調及驗收預約，可消除各工序之間的空檔延誤。

分房間逐一翻新是否比全屋一起翻新耗時更長？

是——分次安排各自獨立的許可申請、技工預約及材料配送，較一次性全屋翻新總工期通常增加 20% 至 30%。全屋同步翻新亦可減少多次進場及設備安置的成本。

2026 年溫哥華全屋翻新造價多少？

溫哥華及低陸平原全屋翻新造價通常在每平方英尺 150 至 400 加元之間，視乎工程範圍及用料檔次而定。含新廚房、兩套衛浴及地板的 2,000 平方英尺全屋翻新，連許可證及人工在內通常落在 30 萬至 50 萬加元區間。詳見 2026 年廚房翻新造價指南，內含逐項費用分析。
